question.html:
In an experiment investigating the photoelectric effect, light of various frequencies is incident on a clean metal surface in a vacuum tube.

a

Explain, with reference to the photon model of light, why there exists a threshold frequency for the emission of electrons from a metal surface.

[2]

b

A graph is plotted showing the variation of the maximum kinetic energy of the photoelectrons against the frequency of the incident light. State the name of the physical constant given by the gradient of the line.

[1]

c

Describe how the threshold frequency and the work function of the metal can be identified using the intercepts of this graph.

[2]
